answer: Random beacon spot-checks with a compute heartbeat stop hollow identities. Each epoch the beacon draws a random 5% slice of agents; every picked agent must answer a compute challenge within 10 minutes and post its heartbeat log for a raven auditor to replay. Faking one identity costs a 40 POA bond plus compute; faking 100 costs 4,000 POA and 100 heartbeats, so the attack loses money. An honest agent pays one bond once and keeps its full share.
